text: An Israel Institute of NZ thread attributes a promise to rearm, carry out another massacre and annihilate Israel to Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya.
The Jews are 'cowards,' 'impure schemers', 'can't be trusted', and may rape the Arab women

Echoing a previous survey, nearly three in four Palestinians believe that Hamas was right in launching its Oct. 7 cross-border attack, in which terrorists savagely murdered more than 1,200 people in Israel according to the Palestinian Center for Policy and Survey Research.

According to the Arab World for Research and Development (AWRAD) research firm in Ramallah, Palestinian civilians overwhelmingly support Hamas’ attacks on Israel that killed over 1,400, including children and babies, and which resulted in 240 hostages taken, including children and babies.
Two years after the war began, 53% of Palestinians still say the decision by Hamas to launch the October 7 attack was correct.
A Palestinian father wishes for his second son's death, 'Allah willing'

13 year old Iman Zaher, from the village of Luban a-Sharqiya: 'I want peace without the Jews. ... Peace with ourselves, peace between Arabs. Without Jews.' ...  'In the schools, they teach us that there is no such thing as Jews, that our right is there should be a state of Palestine with no Jews in it.' 'Of course I want to visit [Jaffa, Haifa], but only after liberation, when there are no Jews there.' 'It's not called Tel Aviv. Tal Al-Rabia, Yaffa, Haifa, these were Arabic names, not Jewish names.' 'It's impossible to have two states in one state. There must be one state here. Palestine, not Israel.' 'Our main goal is that there are no Jews.'
Senior Hamas Official Osama Hamdan: I promise that a war of liberation is coming soon – not just another October 7.

Palestinian Authority Shari'ah Judge Abdallah Harb on official PA TV: 'Allah, strike the aggressive Jews, strike them and their allies.' ... 'O Allah, kill them one by one. Count them and kill them by one, and do not leave even one of them.'
After England, Canada, France and Australia recognized a Palestinian state, Palestinians in the 'moderate' West Bank (Judea and Samaria) say they don't want to live in peace with the Jews.
Jamil Ziyada Hamas TV commentator: We cannot coexist with the Jews, life is all about fighting, not negotiations.

Lebanese Sunni scholar Sheikh Yahya Araji: 'There will be no peace or recognition of Israel. It will remain the enemy of every Muslim until it is destroyed. Al-Sharaa achieved victory by Allah instilling fear in his enemies, and Israel's 'real enemy' has now arrived.'

Jordanian Deputy Parliament Speaker Khamis Atieh: 'The Zionists cannot be trusted, the Jews deceived the prophets. We do not recognize the division of Jerusalem into East and West, we want all of it, all of Palestine. The Zionist entity is a cancer.'

Mourners at Walid Majdi Haniyeh’s funeral in Gaza invoke Khaybar and chant that October 7 will return.
Nawaf Al-Takrouri defends October 7 in religious terms and describes Gaza’s destruction and potentially a million deaths as a price for liberating Al-Aqsa.

Hussain Abdul-Hussain reports a Muslim Brotherhood senior media manager from Qatar, Waddah Khanfar, says that Islam must stand with Iran until Israe is destroyed even if tens of thousands of people are killed.
A December 2022 Mahmoud al-Zahar interview invokes Islamic prophecy and describes a worldwide order without Zionism or “treacherous Christianity.”
Hamas official Osama Hamdan celebrates October 7 and urges supporters abroad to wage jihad wherever and however they can.
A Palestinian man interviewed by Al Jazeera says he would not regret October 7, rejecting regret for the attack on Israel.
In Pierre Rehov’s interviews, a Palestinian suicide-bombing advocate says he would blow himself up in a nursery and feel no sorrow for Israeli children.
Hamas official Fathi Hammad urges Palestinians abroad to slaughter Jews around the world with knives and explosive belts.
An October 2025 Palestinian survey reports 60% satisfaction with Hamas’s wartime performance and a plurality choosing armed struggle as the most effective route forward.
In a video chat, a Hamas supporter says he would kill an Israeli baby first so the mother cries, then shoot the mother; he laughs when asked whether Islam is a religion of peace.

Eyal Yakoby shares a clip attributed to Hamas commanders threatening to pursue Jews and Christians worldwide and kill those who refuse to convert to Islam. “Our issue is not just Palestine, our issue is killing every non-Muslim. We will pursue Jews and Christians all over the world. Either they convert to Islam or we’ll kill them!”
Released Palestinian prisoner Dr. Azmi al-Dawahid declares that Israel will disappear and calls its destruction Allah’s promise, in a clip shared by Vivid.
A Gazan woman says she has no problem with Hamas so long as it wipes Jews off the map, corrects herself to “Israel,” then asks what the difference is.
Hamas claims responsibility for an attempted kidnapping of an Israeli soldier in Gaza shortly before the October 2025 ceasefire; Ayn Reagan warns that hostage deals reward further kidnappings.
Gazans celebrate the October 7 massacre’s second anniversary; a speaker boasts, “On October 7th, we invaded you and trampled you with our boots.”
